relationships.subject: androgen receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar to GDX males and normal females, the mechanical pain thresholds in AR-cKO males was significantly lower than in wild-type (WT; ARflox/y) males (Fig. 4B)

relationships.subject: androgen receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: These results confirm that AR signaling in primary sensory neurons positively regulates the excitability of mechanical pain–responsive SDH neurons.

relationships.subject: DHT
relationships.evidence_quote: The increase in mechanical pain thresholds on day 1 after DHT administration (100 mg/kg, i.p.) was almost completely abolished in AR-cKO females (Fig. 7B)

relationships.subject: DHT
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemical analysis revealed a marked increase in AR protein expression overlapped with NeuN in the DRG of females on day 1 after DHT administration (100 mg/kg, i.p.) (Figs. 6C and D).

key_findings: Sensory neuron AR (greatest in CGRP+ neurons) regulates mechanical but not thermal or chemical pain sensitivity in both sexes.
Sensory neuron AR-cKO increases dorsal horn neuron firing and abolishes DHT-induced threshold increase in females.
